description: Discriminates the position after a Seek that finds nothing (r-cursor-1/seek-arguments shows BOF False, EOF False, no current row, and a MoveNext that succeeds). Table C, Index PK_C (A ASC, B DESC): rows in index order (1,30),(1,20),(1,10),(2,10). On one recordset with held Fields A and B, each step seeks and then moves, reading NoMatch, BOF, EOF, A and B: a miss past the end (= 9,9) followed by MovePrevious, by MoveNext twice, by Move 0 and Bookmark, by MoveFirst and by MoveLast; a miss inside the order (= 1,25) followed by MoveNext and by MovePrevious; > 2,10 (nothing after) followed by MovePrevious and MoveNext; < 1,30 (nothing before) followed by MovePrevious and MoveNext. Decides whether a miss keeps the insertion point or a direction end. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
